claims.text: ap_forecast has no database; no migrations exist or are required.

The feature design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope. The data in scope is held in memory: the paid_date key, a reject reason, the delay history, the risk map, overdue rows and CT-1 JSON.
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage; only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
NF-10: every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs.

The Data Science lane has two tasks. TSK-03 adds vendor_risk in a new risk.py, with no LLM, no network and no models.json read. TSK-04 adds risk=None to build_explanation_request, and models.json must not change.
ap_forecast changes are a new src/ap_forecast/risk.py, an additive change to explain.py, and an export plus version step in __init__.py; predict.py and models.json stay unchanged.
The ap_forecast package exports only predict_delay_days and build_explanation_request, at version 0.9.0, with no database or connection setup.
predict_delay_days is a pure calculation (rounded mean of the history) with no storage.
explain.load_config reads the local models.json file, and build_explanation_request returns a dict without writing anything.
models.json is static configuration (provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, max_tokens 300), not a database.
Any storage or network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01; the current design triggers none of the DES-01 triggers.

No open questions.
